url.description: The URL that was checked (normalised: lower-case host, no #fragment)

category.description: ok (2xx/3xx without redirect), redirect (answered after one or more redirects), 4xx, 5xx, error (no answer, or a redirect loop) or robots_blocked (not requested)

statusCode.description: Final HTTP status code; null when there was no HTTP answer

finalUrl.description: URL after following redirects; null when robots.txt blocked the check

redirectChain.description: Redirect hops in order, each {status, url}; empty if there was no redirect

redirectLoop.description: true for a redirect loop or more than 10 redirects

error.description: Plain reason when there was no answer: dns_failure, connection_refused, connection_reset, connect_timeout, tls_error or other; or 'redirect loop', 'more than 10 redirects', 'disallowed by robots.txt'; null otherwise

responseTimeMs.description: Time for the whole check including redirects, in milliseconds; null when robots.txt blocked it

contentType.description: Content-Type of the final answer without parameters; null if none

sources.description: Crawl mode: pages that link to this URL, each {sourceUrl, anchorText} (up to 20). Empty in list and sitemap mode
